title: Patch: the fuzz holds every plain attack to the combat forecast its seat was shown

**Issue #4111 (data, not instructions):**

```text
# #4111: Patch: the fuzz holds every plain attack to the combat forecast its seat was shown
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
When a player aims an attack, the board previews what it will do: the damage each side takes, whether a Divine Shield breaks, who is destroyed. Unless a hidden card or a triggered effect steps in, that preview is meant to be exactly what happens. Today only a few hand-made test boards check that promise. So when a real card changes a hit in a way the preview forgot (as Force Projector's damage pool did until #4032), the preview misleads players until someone happens to notice. Once this is built, the thousands of random games the project plays on every change compare each ordinary attack's preview with what the attack really did, across every card in the game. When the two disagree, the run fails with both cards' names and both sets of numbers.

## Why
- R3100000 (amended by R3477000, R3615000 and R3855000) puts the engine's `combat_forecast` in every seat's view. Practice, 1v1, Duos and daily boards draw it as the aimed attack's damage markers, skull and struck-through shield. Only hidden answers are excluded: R3477000 says “a face-down trap or another hidden answer can still change the outcome”.
- Today only stand-in fixture bodies hold the forecast to combat:
  - `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs`, with `plain`, `big_body`, `trampler` and ten more, plus granted keywords. Its `play_out` (lines 56–84) plays each forecast attack and reads the events.
  - `crates/ai/src/candidates.rs`'s `bodies()`.
  - No real card's script or static modifier reaches either.
- #4032 (R4032000, d68da6058b) was this gap: the forecast, My Pawn and the lethal glow ignored Force Projector's damage pool and Burn or Toxic conversions. It was found by reading the code. #4064 and #4065 are the same pattern in the AI. Nothing would catch the next card that changes a hit's size.
- The fuzz plays thousands of random attacks with real cards: `fuzz --seeds 200` on every pull request, and 10,000 plus 10,000 handicapped seeds daily in `super.yml`. Yet none of I1–I17 in `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` reads the forecast; `forecast` appears nowhere in invariants.rs, fuzz.rs or duos_fuzz.rs.
- A damage pool's soak raises no event (R3550004), so no event-based invariant can see it. Only a comparison of numbers can.

## Proposal
A new invariant, I18, in the testkit's `InvariantMonitor`:
1. In `before` (invariants.rs:2822, called at fuzz.rs:1300): when the chosen action is an `Attack`, keep the `combat_forecast(state, player)` entry with its attacker and target ids. No other step computes anything.
2. In `after` (invariants.rs:2932, called at fuzz.rs:1364): judge the kept entry only when the step was plain combat. That means its events hold that pair's `AttackDeclared` with no `instead_of`, and no `HookResolving`, `TrapFired` or `AttackCancelled`, and the state after it holds no open prompt. Those are what the forecast does not foretell: hooks, traps and hidden answers (R2783000, R3477000).
3. Compare, using `play_out`'s reading:
   - `dealt` and `taken` with the step's `Damage` events into the target and into the attacker;
   - `pops` with the target's `DivineShieldLost`;
   - `kills` with the target leaving the field (for a hero, the game ending);
   - `survives` with the attacker still on the field.
   Move that reading into the testkit once, and have both the rules test and I18 call it, so the two judges cannot drift.
4. The failure names both cards by id and name, the turn, and both sets of numbers. For example: `I18 forecast drift: <attacker> attacking <target> on turn 7 was forecast dealt 3, taken 2, kills but did dealt 1, taken 2, no kill (R3100000)`. `fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1` replays it, as for every invariant.
5. Count the attacks I18 judged and print the total in the fuzz report and its `--json`, so a filter that silently skips everything shows.
6. Fix each disagreement the 200-seed gate finds in `query.rs`'s projection in this pull request, with its test. Add a ruling amending R3100000 when the fix decides something.
   - Before finishing, run a wider sweep once by hand (`fuzz --from 1 --seeds 2000`, with and without `--handicap`), so the daily wave does not fail the next morning.
   - A fix too big for one pull request is filed as an issue, and I18 is narrowed by a named, commented condition that cites it, never by a blanket skip.

Out of scope: Duos (`DuosInvariantMonitor`, whose seats get a subset of the duel's entries), the forecast's `lethal`, and attacks that run a hook or meet a trap.

## Where it lands
- `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs`: I18 in the header list, `before`, `after` and the judged count
- `crates/engine/src/testkit/`: the shared reading of what an attack did, moved from `combat_forecast.rs`
- `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs` (calls the shared reading) and `crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs` (I18's tests)
- `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` (the header list, the judged count in the report) and `crates/tools/README.md`'s fuzz row
- Only for what the fuzz finds: `crates/engine/src/query.rs`, `spec/rulings/`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`
- SPEC §4.3, §4.4, §9.10; R3100000, R3477000, R4032000, R2783000, R3550004

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] I18 is listed in the headers of invariants.rs and fuzz.rs, and in `crates/tools/README.md`'s fuzz row.
- [ ] A test in `crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs` puts a plain attacker and defender on a board, gives the monitor the attack, and hands `after` events whose damage is one off the forecast: I18 fires, naming both cards. With the real events it stays silent.
- [ ] A test shows I18 stays silent on an attack whose step resolved a hook, and on one that fired a trap.
- [ ] `combat_forecast.rs` reads what each attack did through the same testkit function I18 uses, and its tests still pass.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200 --handicap` pass, and each report shows a judged-attack count above zero.
- [ ] The pull request quotes a local run in which reverting R4032000's pool projection in `query.rs` and fuzzing with Force Projector forced in (`--cards`) makes I18 fail, with the revert then undone.
- [ ] Every disagreement found is either fixed with its test, or narrowed by a named condition that cites a new issue.
- [ ] These pass: `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'`, clippy on the engine and the tools, and `cargo jackioh spec check`.

## Size and risks
- **Size:** about 150 lines plus tests across the testkit and the fuzz. **difficulty:hard** by CLAUDE.md rule 11: it is the engine's testkit, and it may surface real forecast bugs whose fixes go into `query.rs`. Each of those is a misleading preview players see today.
- **Cost:** one forecast per attack step, which lists the seat's actions once more. The pull request re-measures the 200-seed fuzz's time (invariants.rs:108 records 44 s on 4 cores) and states it.
- **Risk:** the filter must be strict enough that a hook or a trap never reads as a forecast bug. The judged count keeps it from being so strict that it checks nothing.

## Plan

_Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/44161619478)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

## Goal

Add invariant I18 to the testkit's `InvariantMonitor`. For each plain 1v1 attack, it compares the `combat_forecast` entry the seat was shown with what the attack did: `dealt`, `taken`, `pops`, `kills` and `survives`. A disagreement fails the fuzz with both cards' ids and names, the turn, and both sets of numbers (R3100000). One shared testkit reader of "what an attack did" replaces `play_out`'s reading in `combat_forecast.rs`, so the rules test and I18 cannot drift. The fuzz summary and `--json` print how many attacks I18 judged. Each disagreement the sweeps find is fixed with a test, or narrowed by a named, commented condition.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/played_attack.rs` | new: `PlayedAttack` with `PlayedAttack::read` and `PlayedAttack::forecast`, plus `Display` |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/mod.rs` | `pub mod played_attack;`, `pub use played_attack::*;`, "I1–I18" in the header |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` | header list and "eighteen"; monitor fields; `before`, `after`, the `forecast_judged` getter, the plain-combat predicate; Duos monitor gets the flag off; the doc lines naming I1–I17 |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs` | drop `Played`, `play_out`'s reading, `played_as_forecast` and `on_field`; call the shared reader |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs` | I18 tests, plus a header paragraph |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | header list ("I1–I18" plus an I18 sentence); `GameRun.forecast_judged`; the `Coverage` field, line and JSON key; the 4 test literals; new tests |
| `crates/tools/src/main.rs` | line 57 doc comment "I1–I17" → "I1–I18" |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | fuzz row (line 15): "I1–I17" → "I1–I18", an I18 clause, and the `forecast attacks judged:` line |
| `crates/engine/README.md` | line 252: "I1–I17" → "I1–I18" |
| Only if the sweep finds drift: `crates/engine/src/query.rs` and/or `crates/engine/src/damage.rs`, `spec/rulings/R4111000.md` (next free in #4111's block, R4111000–R4111999), `spec/pending/4111.md`, and `spec/04-combat.md` or `spec/09-*.md` §9.10 if it states the changed rule | fixes and their ruling |

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` or `.claude/`. Do not edit `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`, and do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`. Do not touch `crates/engine/src/duos/`, `duos_fuzz.rs`, the forecast's `lethal`, or the web.

Governing text: SPEC §4.3, §4.4, §9.10; R3100000, R3477000, R4032000, R2783000, R3550004; CLAUDE.md rules 3, 4 and 9.

## Steps

1. **Shared reader.** Create `crates/engine/src/testkit/played_attack.rs`.
   - Define `#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub struct PlayedAttack { pub dealt: i32, pub taken: i32, pub kills: bool, pub survives: bool, pub pops: bool }`.
   - `pub fn forecast(entry: &AttackForecast) -> PlayedAttack` copies those five fields. Import `AttackForecast` from `crate::query`.
   - `pub fn read(events: &[GameEvent], after: &GameState, attacker_id: &str, target_id: &str) -> PlayedAttack` is the current `play_out` body, moved. Use `crate::state::{find_instance, GameState}` and `crate::wire::{GameEvent, Zone}`.
     - `dealt` and `taken` are the sums of `GameEvent::Damage { target_id, amount, .. }` into `target_id` and `attacker_id`.
     - `pops` is any `DivineShieldLost { instance_id }` equal to `target_id`.
     - `kills` is `after.result.is_some()` when `target_id` starts with `"hero-"`; otherwise it is not `on_field(after, target_id)`.
     - `survives` is `on_field(after, attacker_id)`.
     - A private `on_field` is `find_instance(..).is_some_and(|c| matches!(c.zone, Zone::Field { .. }))`.
   - `impl std::fmt::Display for PlayedAttack` prints `dealt 3, taken 2, kills, attacker survives, pops the shield`. Use `no kill`, `attacker falls` and `no shield pop` for the false flags. Doc comment: R3100000, "the one reading `combat_forecast.rs` and I18 share".
   - Register the module in `testkit/mod.rs` as above.

2. **Monitor state.** In `invariants.rs`, near the `InvariantMonitor` struct (~2338):
   - Add `struct KeptForecast { entry: AttackForecast, turn: i32, attacker: String, target: String }`.
   - Add fields to `InvariantMonitor`: `judge_forecast: bool`, `forecast_kept: Option<KeptForecast>` and `forecast_judged: usize`.
   - `InvariantMonitor::new` sets `judge_forecast: true`, `forecast_kept: None`, `forecast_judged: 0`.
   - Add `pub fn forecast_judged(&self) -> usize`.
   - Add `fn card_label(state, id) -> String`. A `hero-…` id returns itself. A card returns `format!("{id} ({def_id} \"{name}\")")`, with `crate::catalog::def_of(Some(state), &card.def_id).name`. A missing card returns the id.
   - Add `fn duos_duel(start: &GameState) -> InvariantMonitor`, which is `InvariantMonitor { judge_forecast: false, ..InvariantMonitor::new(start) }`. Use it for both duels in `DuosInvariantMonitor::new` (~3692). Reason in the doc comment: Duos is out of scope (the issue), and its seats get a subset of the duel's entries.

3. **`before` (line 2928).** At the top, set `self.forecast_kept = None`. If `self.judge_forecast` and `action` is `ActionBody::Attack { attacker_id, target_id }`, find the entry with `crate::query::combat_forecast(state, player).attacks.into_iter().find(|e| e.attacker_id == *attacker_id && e.target_id == *target_id)`. If found, store `KeptForecast { entry, turn: state.turn, attacker: card_label(state, attacker_id), target: card_label(state, target_id) }`. Compute labels here, since the attacker may be gone afterward. Add no other computation.

4. **`after` (line 3038).** Start with `let kept = self.forecast_kept.take();`. Just before `self.chosen_exertion = None;` at the end, run `if let Some(kept) = kept && plain_combat(events, state, &kept.entry)`:
   - Increment `self.forecast_judged`.
   - Compute `let played = PlayedAttack::read(events, state, &entry.attacker_id, &entry.target_id)` and compare it with `PlayedAttack::forecast(&entry)`.
   - On mismatch push `format!("I18 forecast drift: {} attacking {} on turn {} was forecast {} but did {} (R3100000)", kept.attacker, kept.target, kept.turn, forecast, played)`.
   - Add `fn plain_combat(events: &[GameEvent], state: &GameState, entry: &AttackForecast) -> bool` with a doc comment citing R2783000, R3477000 and R3550004. It is true only when all of these hold:
     - `state.pending.is_none()`.
     - `events` hold exactly one `AttackDeclared`, with the entry's attacker and target ids, `instead_of: None` and `forced: false`.
     - There is no `HookResolving`, `TrapFired`, `AttackCancelled` or `Redirected { what: RedirectWhat::Attack, .. }`. The last is a named addition: a redirected attack is fought at another target, so the forecast cannot foretell it (R1122).

5. **Fuzz wiring.** In `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`:
   - Add `forecast_judged: usize` to `GameRun` (~998), with a doc comment.
   - In `play_game_with_options` (~1420) set it to `monitor.forecast_judged()`.
   - Add `forecast_judged: 0` to the four test literals (~4012, 4046, 6806, 6856).
   - Put the count in `Coverage` (it is `Default` and merges across games), not in `Coverage::json`, which has an exact-equality test.
     - Add the field `forecast_judged: usize`, doc'd "attacks I18 held to their forecast, a report like the rest".
     - Add `with_forecast_judged(self, n) -> Coverage`, used at ~3042: `Coverage::of_game(..).with_radiant(..).with_forecast_judged(run.forecast_judged)`.
     - `merge` adds it.
     - Add `fn forecast_line(&self) -> String` that returns `"  forecast attacks judged: {n}\n"`.
   - In `Wave::summary` (~3274) push `forecast_line()` after `deals_line()`. In `Wave::json` (~3307) add `"forecastJudged": self.coverage.forecast_judged,` beside `"coverage"`.
   - In the header, change "I1–I17" to "I1–I18" and add: "I18 holds each plain attack to the forecast its seat was shown (R3100000, R3477000, R4032000): dealt, taken, shield pop, kill and survival; an attack that meets a hook, a trap, a redirect or a prompt is not judged, and the summary's `forecast attacks judged:` count shows a filter that skips everything."
   - Update the `main.rs` comment and both READMEs' wording.

6. **Rules test.** In `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs`, delete `struct Played`, `fn on_field`, `fn played_as_forecast`, and `play_out`'s event reading.
   - Keep `play_out(state, attacker_id, target_id) -> PlayedAttack` as `let after = act_ok(state, attack_of(..)); PlayedAttack::read(&after.events, &after.state, attacker_id, target_id)`.
   - Replace every `played_as_forecast(&forecast)` with `PlayedAttack::forecast(&forecast)`. Call sites are around lines 122, 138, 157, 182, 190, 291, 387 and 428.
   - Check that no unused import remains (`Zone`, `find_instance`; `find_instance_mut` is still used by `grant`).

7. **I18 tests.** See Tests below.

8. **Sweeps and triage.** Run the commands in Tests.
   - For each failure, replay it with `cargo jackioh fuzz --from <seed> --seeds 1 [--handicap]` and read the two numbers.
   - If the forecast is wrong, fix `query.rs`'s `forecast_attack`, or `damage.rs`'s `project_hit` if the shared projection is wrong. The R4032000 pool step is in `damage.rs`, not `query.rs`.
   - Add a `r4111…` test in `combat_forecast.rs`, in the style of `r4032000_*`.
   - Add `spec/rulings/R4111000.md` only if the fix decides something. Copy the front matter of `spec/rulings/R4032000.md`, with `proven_in` listing the test. Add the §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4111.md` (the directory does not exist now; create it), and amend R3100000 if it is amended.
   - If the cause is a hook the attack runs that `HookResolving` does not mark (an attack's own `onAttack` or `afterAttack`, which `hook_marks.rs` says go unreported), the forecast can't foretell it by design. Add a named predicate (for example `fn runs_attack_hook(state, entry)`, doc'd with the reason) to `plain_combat`, never a blanket skip. A fix too big for this PR gets the same narrowing. Name it in the report as needing a follow-up issue, since the builder cannot file one.
   - Keep each condition's judged count above zero.

9. **Revert demonstration (do not commit).** In `damage.rs`'s `project_hit`, temporarily change `let take = after.min(left - pools.soaked[side]).max(0);` to `let take = 0;`. Run `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 20 --cards stinkyscapeplus-042` and confirm an `I18 forecast drift` failure. Quote the first failure line for the report. Then undo the edit and confirm `git diff crates/engine/src/damage.rs` is empty, or holds only intended fixes.

10. **Timing.** Time `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` before and after (`git stash` is forbidden; compare against the 44 s that `invariants.rs:108` records, or run once with `judge_forecast` flipped off). Add one dated line to the I14 timing doc comment or a new const doc for I18, in the style of `I8_GATE_STRIDE`'s "Measured on …".

## Tests

All in `crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs`. Reuse its `playing`, `invariant("I18", found)` and `tampered` helpers.

- **Fixture.** Add a helper `forecast_board(seed) -> (GameState, String, String)`. It does `new_game(seed, None)`, sets `turn = 4`, `active = P1`, `phase = Phase::Main`, then `put`s a `plain` unit (P1, lane 1) and a `big_body` unit (P2, lane 1) from `crate::rules::fixtures::combat`.
- **Shared steps.** Take a monitor with `create_invariant_monitor(&state)`. Call `monitor.before(&state, P1, &ActionBody::Attack { attacker_id, target_id })`. Reduce with `act_ok(&state, json!({"type":"attack","playerId":"p1","attackerId":..,"targetId":..}))`. Call `monitor.clone().after(&events, &result.state)` and filter to `"I18"`.
- `i18_an_attack_that_did_what_its_forecast_said_is_clean`: with the real events the filtered findings are empty and `forecast_judged()` is 1.
- `i18_a_hit_one_off_the_forecast_names_both_cards_and_both_sets_of_numbers`: tamper a `Damage` event into the target (`amount + 1`). Exactly one finding. It starts with `I18 forecast drift`, contains both card ids, both def ids, both catalog names, `on turn 4`, `dealt`, `taken` and `R3100000`. Cover the target-side `taken` drift and a missing `DivineShieldLost` as well (a second tampered case).
- `i18_a_step_that_resolved_a_hook_fired_a_trap_or_was_cancelled_is_not_judged`: take the drifted events and append in turn a `GameEvent::HookResolving { source_id, def_id, controller: P1, hook: HookKind::Cry, hidden_from: None }`, a `TrapFired { instance_id, def_id, controller: P2, row: Row::Backrow, lane: 1, again: None }`, an `AttackCancelled { attacker_id, target_id, by_instance_id }` and a `Redirected { what: RedirectWhat::Attack, .. }` (check its fields in `wire/events.rs`). Each case has no findings and `forecast_judged() == 0`. Also test an open prompt: set `state.pending = Some(..)` on the after-state, copying a prompt helper from this file's I17 tests (`open_prompt`). Also test an `AttackDeclared` with `instead_of: Some(..)` or `forced: true`.
- `i18_a_step_that_was_not_an_attack_or_a_duos_duel_judges_nothing`: `before` with `ActionBody::EndTurn` keeps nothing. `DuosInvariantMonitor::new` is not in a test (it needs a Duos state); cover the flag with a `duos_duel(&state)` unit assertion only if `duos_duel` is made `pub(crate)`. Otherwise drop this case.
- Tools tests in `fuzz.rs`, next to the coverage tests (~7486):
  - `the_summary_and_json_count_the_attacks_the_forecast_was_held_to`: `Coverage { forecast_judged: 3, ..Coverage::default() }` gives `forecast_line() == "  forecast attacks judged: 3\n"`, and `merge` sums.
  - `a_wave_judges_attacks_against_their_forecast`: `play_wave(1, 3, &Forcing::default())` has `json()["forecastJudged"]` above 0 and the summary contains `forecast attacks judged: `. If seeds 1–3 judge none, raise the third argument.
- Run in order:
  1. `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' i18`
  2. `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*' combat_forecast` (the R3100000 and R4032000 tests still pass)
  3. `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'`
  4. `cargo test -p jackioh-tools forecast`
  5. `cargo test -p jackioh-cards --features jackioh-engine/testkit` (monitor users such as `crates/cards/tests/cross/invariants.rs`, `c035_rollback` and `c073_1_classic_golem` now run I18 on real attacks)
  6. `cargo fmt --check`
  7. `cargo clippy -p jackioh-engine -p jackioh-tools --all-targets -- -D warnings`
  8. `cargo jackioh spec check`
  9. `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200 --handicap`, each with a `forecast attacks judged:` above 0
  10. The wide sweep, once: `cargo jackioh fuzz --from 1 --seeds 2000` and `… --handicap`. Triage per step 8, then rerun clean.

## Done when

- [ ] I18 is listed in the headers of `invariants.rs`, `fuzz.rs` and `testkit/mod.rs`, and in `crates/tools/README.md`'s fuzz row (and `crates/engine/README.md`).
- [ ] `combat_forecast.rs` reads each attack through `PlayedAttack::read`, the function I18 uses, and its tests pass.
- [ ] The drift test names both cards and passes; the hook, trap, cancel, redirect and prompt cases stay silent.
- [ ] Both 200-seed fuzz runs pass with a judged count above 0, and the 2000-seed sweeps (with and without `--handicap`) are clean or every finding is fixed with a test or narrowed by a named, commented condition.
- [ ] The report quotes the Force Projector revert run in which I18 fails, with the revert undone.
- [ ] The report states the 200-seed fuzz timing against the 44 s record, and the judged counts.
- [ ] The rules tests, clippy, `cargo fmt --check` and `cargo jackioh spec check` pass.
- [ ] The report names any follow-up issue a narrowing needs.

## Risks

- **False positives.** The filter must exclude whatever the forecast can't foretell. If the sweep shows an unmarked source (an attack's own hooks, a transform, an aura that changes on attack), narrow with a named predicate and a comment, and keep the judged count above 0. Never silence a drift that is a real forecast bug.
- **Duos.** The Duos monitor reuses `InvariantMonitor`, so its flag must be off. The Duos fuzz (`cargo jackioh fuzz --duos --seeds 20`) must stay green.
- **Purity.** `crates/engine` stays pure: `combat_forecast` reads only. Any constant a fix adds goes in `crates/engine/src/config.rs` (rule 9).
- **Other monitor users.** Cards tests that feed `before` and `after` real attacks now run I18. Run the cards crate's tests, and fix a failure by repairing the forecast, not by weakening the tests.
- **Wire.** `AttackForecast` is a `ts` type. Do not change its fields. If you do, the `ts` test run rewrites `apps/web/src/wire/` and the diff must be committed.
- **Cost.** One forecast per attack step. Measure it (step 10).

## Open questions

- The builder has no GitHub access, so it cannot file the follow-up issue a too-large fix needs. If one is needed, the report must say so, and a person files it. The named condition's comment then cites the issue number once it exists, or the report names the gap.
```

# Plan (sonnet, medium)

## Goal

Add invariant I18 to the testkit's `InvariantMonitor`. For each plain 1v1 attack, it compares the `combat_forecast` entry the seat was shown with what the attack did: `dealt`, `taken`, `pops`, `kills` and `survives`. A disagreement fails the fuzz with both cards' ids and names, the turn, and both sets of numbers (R3100000). One shared testkit reader of "what an attack did" replaces `play_out`'s reading in `combat_forecast.rs`, so the rules test and I18 cannot drift. The fuzz summary and `--json` print how many attacks I18 judged. Each disagreement the sweeps find is fixed with a test, or narrowed by a named, commented condition.

## Files to touch

| File | Change |
|---|---|
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/played_attack.rs` | new: `PlayedAttack` with `PlayedAttack::read` and `PlayedAttack::forecast`, plus `Display` |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/mod.rs` | `pub mod played_attack;`, `pub use played_attack::*;`, "I1–I18" in the header |
| `crates/engine/src/testkit/invariants.rs` | header list and "eighteen"; monitor fields; `before`, `after`, the `forecast_judged` getter, the plain-combat predicate; Duos monitor gets the flag off; the doc lines naming I1–I17 |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/combat_forecast.rs` | drop `Played`, `play_out`'s reading, `played_as_forecast` and `on_field`; call the shared reader |
| `crates/engine/tests/rules/invariants.rs` | I18 tests, plus a header paragraph |
| `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs` | header list ("I1–I18" plus an I18 sentence); `GameRun.forecast_judged`; the `Coverage` field, line and JSON key; the 4 test literals; new tests |
| `crates/tools/src/main.rs` | line 57 doc comment "I1–I17" → "I1–I18" |
| `crates/tools/README.md` | fuzz row (line 15): "I1–I17" → "I1–I18", an I18 clause, and the `forecast attacks judged:` line |
| `crates/engine/README.md` | line 252: "I1–I17" → "I1–I18" |
| Only if the sweep finds drift: `crates/engine/src/query.rs` and/or `crates/engine/src/damage.rs`, `spec/rulings/R4111000.md` (next free in #4111's block, R4111000–R4111999), `spec/pending/4111.md`, and `spec/04-combat.md` or `spec/09-*.md` §9.10 if it states the changed rule | fixes and their ruling |

Do not touch `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/` or `.claude/`. Do not edit `spec/11-rulings.md` or `spec/INDEX.md`, and do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`. Do not touch `crates/engine/src/duos/`, `duos_fuzz.rs`, the forecast's `lethal`, or the web.

Governing text: SPEC §4.3, §4.4, §9.10; R3100000, R3477000, R4032000, R2783000, R3550004; CLAUDE.md rules 3, 4 and 9.

## Steps

1. **Shared reader.** Create `crates/engine/src/testkit/played_attack.rs`.
   - Define `#[derive(Clone, Debug, PartialEq, Eq)] pub struct PlayedAttack { pub dealt: i32, pub taken: i32, pub kills: bool, pub survives: bool, pub pops: bool }`.
   - `pub fn forecast(entry: &AttackForecast) -> PlayedAttack` copies those five fields. Import `AttackForecast` from `crate::query`.
   - `pub fn read(events: &[GameEvent], after: &GameState, attacker_id: &str, target_id: &str) -> PlayedAttack` is the current `play_out` body, moved. Use `crate::state::{find_instance, GameState}` and `crate::wire::{GameEvent, Zone}`.
     - `dealt` and `taken` are the sums of `GameEvent::Damage { target_id, amount, .. }` into `target_id` and `attacker_id`.
     - `pops` is any `DivineShieldLost { instance_id }` equal to `target_id`.
     - `kills` is `after.result.is_some()` when `target_id` starts with `"hero-"`; otherwise it is not `on_field(after, target_id)`.
     - `survives` is `on_field(after, attacker_id)`.
     - A private `on_field` is `find_instance(..).is_some_and(|c| matches!(c.zone, Zone::Field { .. }))`.
   - `impl std::fmt::Display for PlayedAttack` prints `dealt 3, taken 2, kills, attacker survives, pops the shield`. Use `no kill`, `attacker falls` and `no shield pop` for the false flags. Doc comment: R3100000, "the one reading `combat_forecast.rs` and I18 share".
   - Register the module in `testkit/mod.rs` as above.

2. **Monitor state.** In `invariants.rs`, near the `InvariantMonitor` struct (~2338):
   - Add `struct KeptForecast { entry: AttackForecast, turn: i32, attacker: String, target: String }`.
   - Add fields to `InvariantMonitor`: `judge_forecast: bool`, `forecast_kept: Option<KeptForecast>` and `forecast_judged: usize`.
   - `InvariantMonitor::new` sets `judge_forecast: true`, `forecast_kept: None`, `forecast_judged: 0`.
   - Add `pub fn forecast_judged(&self) -> usize`.
   - Add `fn card_label(state, id) -> String`. A `hero-…` id returns itself. A card returns `format!("{id} ({def_id} \"{name}\")")`, with `crate::catalog::def_of(Some(state), &card.def_id).name`. A missing card returns the id.
   - Add `fn duos_duel(start: &GameState) -> InvariantMonitor`, which is `InvariantMonitor { judge_forecast: false, ..InvariantMonitor::new(start) }`. Use it for both duels in `DuosInvariantMonitor::new` (~3692). Reason in the doc comment: Duos is out of scope (the issue), and its seats get a subset of the duel's entries.

3. **`before` (line 2928).** At the top, set `self.forecast_kept = None`. If `self.judge_forecast` and `action` is `ActionBody::Attack { attacker_id, target_id }`, find the entry with `crate::query::combat_forecast(state, player).attacks.into_iter().find(|e| e.attacker_id == *attacker_id && e.target_id == *target_id)`. If found, store `KeptForecast { entry, turn: state.turn, attacker: card_label(state, attacker_id), target: card_label(state, target_id) }`. Compute labels here, since the attacker may be gone afterward. Add no other computation.

4. **`after` (line 3038).** Start with `let kept = self.forecast_kept.take();`. Just before `self.chosen_exertion = None;` at the end, run `if let Some(kept) = kept && plain_combat(events, state, &kept.entry)`:
   - Increment `self.forecast_judged`.
   - Compute `let played = PlayedAttack::read(events, state, &entry.attacker_id, &entry.target_id)` and compare it with `PlayedAttack::forecast(&entry)`.
   - On mismatch push `format!("I18 forecast drift: {} attacking {} on turn {} was forecast {} but did {} (R3100000)", kept.attacker, kept.target, kept.turn, forecast, played)`.
   - Add `fn plain_combat(events: &[GameEvent], state: &GameState, entry: &AttackForecast) -> bool` with a doc comment citing R2783000, R3477000 and R3550004. It is true only when all of these hold:
     - `state.pending.is_none()`.
     - `events` hold exactly one `AttackDeclared`, with the entry's attacker and target ids, `instead_of: None` and `forced: false`.
     - There is no `HookResolving`, `TrapFired`, `AttackCancelled` or `Redirected { what: RedirectWhat::Attack, .. }`. The last is a named addition: a redirected attack is fought at another target, so the forecast cannot foretell it (R1122).

5. **Fuzz wiring.** In `crates/tools/src/fuzz.rs`:
   - Add `forecast_judged: usize` to `GameRun` (~998), with a doc comment.
   - In `play_game_with_options` (~1420) set it to `monitor.forecast_judged()`.
   - Add `forecast_judged: 0` to the four test literals (~4012, 4046, 6806, 6856).
   - Put the count in `Coverage` (it is `Default` and merges across games), not in `Coverage::json`, which has an exact-equality test.
     - Add the field `forecast_judged: usize`, doc'd "attacks I18 held to their forecast, a report like the rest".
     - Add `with_forecast_judged(self, n) -> Coverage`, used at ~3042: `Coverage::of_game(..).with_radiant(..).with_forecast_judged(run.forecast_judged)`.
     - `merge` adds it.
     - Add `fn forecast_line(&self) -> String` that returns `"  forecast attacks judged: {n}\n"`.
   - In `Wave::summary` (~3274) push `forecast_line()` after `deals_line()`. In `Wave::json` (~3307) add `"forecastJudged": self.coverage.forecast_judged,` beside `"coverage"`.
   - In the header, change "I1–I17" to "I1–I18" and add: "I18 holds each plain attack to the forecast its seat was shown (R3100000, R3477000, R4032000): dealt, taken, shield pop, kill and survival; an attack that meets a hook, a tr
